test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, DEAF is coded as 4-10-3-24 and MAGIC is coded as 13-2-21-36-15. How will CLOSET be coded in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: The given words alphabet is multiply with consecutive number which start with 1.**

DEAF is coded as 4-10-3-24

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec18fb9bf2b62d7f55aad75d5ed2e8cd568e97e9dfca074fdc28d059587340a7.png] 

And,

MAGIC is coded as 13-2-21-36-15

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddf9149574e5f51f124d574d9a0e995fd626cedbb7a2c9227baa08fb743a5a4b.png] 

Similarly, 

CLOSET is coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24177f319e4302c0fcb69a8378cbdaedb4b9954469b87e1a8a5f22cb37b78d88.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"3-24-45-76-25-120".**
